{"step":4,"file":"lib/lookup.c","function":"_tr46","line":0,"var":"domain_u32","code":"domain_u32 = u8_to_u32 (domain_u8, u8_strlen (domain_u8) + 1, NULL, &len);","note":"The UTF-8 domain is expanded into a UTF-32 buffer that is later remapped and revalidated label by label."},
{"step":5,"file":"lib/lookup.c","function":"_tr46","line":0,"var":"tmp","code":"uint32_t *tmp = (uint32_t *) malloc ((len2 + 1) * sizeof (uint32_t));","note":"A second buffer is allocated using the computed mapped length; this length is derived from attacker-controlled code points."},
{"step":6,"file":"lib/lookup.c","function":"_tr46","line":0,"var":"tmp[len2++]","code":"tmp[len2++] = c; / get_map_data (tmp + len2, &map);","note":"Mapped or copied code points are written into the temporary buffer, propagating the attacker-controlled domain into the normalized representation."},
{"step":7,"file":"lib/lookup.c","function":"idn2_to_ascii_u8","line":0,"var":"domain_u32","code":"domain_u32 = u32_normalize (UNINORM_NFC, tmp, len2 + 1, NULL, &len);","note":"The mapped buffer is normalized to NFC and becomes the canonical UTF-32 domain used for label processing."},
{"step":8,"file":"lib/lookup.c","function":"idn2_to_ascii_u8","line":449,"var":"end","code":"const uint8_t *end = (uint8_t *) strchrnul ((const char *) src, '.');","note":"The domain is split into labels; each label boundary is determined from attacker-controlled bytes."},
{"step":9,"file":"lib/lookup.c","function":"label","line":0,"var":"dst","code":"memcpy (dst, src, srclen);","note":"For ASCII labels, the label bytes are copied directly into the fixed-size destination buffer after length checks."},
{"step":10,"file":"lib/lookup.c","function":"idn2_to_ascii_u8","line":0,"var":"_lookupname","code":"memcpy (_lookupname + lookupnamelen, tmp, tmplen);","note":"Each converted label is appended into the fixed-size domain output buffer, which is the memory-safety sink if prior length accounting is wrong."}
]
p.write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, ensure_ascii=False))
print(p)
